param.name: govuk.branding
param.desc: Branding mode. 'neutral' (default) uses system fonts and no crown; 'istanduk' adds the iStandUK theme (logo, brand colours) on top of neutral; 'nhs' applies the NHS Design System palette and typography (for NHS organisations only); 'official' applies full GOV.UK branding — the crown logo and GDS Transport font — for genuine GOV.UK services only (see the manual). NHS and official identity assets are restricted; the build warns.

param.name: govuk.service.name
param.desc: Service or publication name shown in the masthead and footer. Defaults to the map title.

param.name: govuk.phase
param.desc: Show a GOV.UK phase banner above the content with this tag, e.g. 'alpha' or 'beta'. Empty (default) shows no banner. Works in every branding mode.

param.name: govuk.feedback.url
param.desc: Feedback link shown in the phase banner (used only when govuk.phase is set). Empty (default) shows the banner text without a link.

param.name: govuk.service.url
param.desc: Target of the masthead home link (service or publication home). Empty (default) links to the generated site's own home page.

param.name: govuk.favicon
param.desc: Path to a favicon file (.ico, .png or .svg) to copy into the output and link from every page. Empty (default) ships no favicon.

param.name: govuk.footer.links
param.desc: Extra footer links, as a semicolon-separated list of 'label|url' pairs (for example 'Privacy|/privacy;Contact|/contact'). Empty (default) shows only the generated support links.

param.name: govuk.footer.licence
param.desc: Override the footer licence/credit line (neutral, iStandUK and NHS modes; official mode always shows the Open Government Licence). Empty (default) uses the bookmap's bookmeta copyright, or the map title.

param.name: govuk.homepage.layout
param.desc: Landing-page layout. 'auto' (default) selects from the map's shape: one top-level entry gives a start-button page, a few give an annotated contents list, many or multi-chapter bookmaps give grouped sections.

param.name: govuk.homepage.depth
param.desc: How many levels of the map the landing page shows (grid, grouped, accordion, and start layouts). 1 = top-level entries only; 2 (default) = entries plus their children; higher values nest deeper.

param.name: govuk.search
param.desc: Site search via Pagefind. 'auto' (default) enables search when the Pagefind binary is found; 'yes' requires it (build fails without it); 'no' disables search.

param.name: govuk.pagefind.cmd
param.desc: Path to the Pagefind executable. Defaults to 'pagefind' on the PATH.

param.name: govuk.pagination
param.desc: Show previous/next links (GOV.UK pagination) at the foot of each page in the map's reading order. 'yes' (default) or 'no'.

param.name: govuk.svg.inline
param.desc: Inline local SVG diagrams (svgref) as native SVG so links and interactivity inside them work. 'yes' (default) inlines; 'no' keeps the image rendering.
